_doc: Single config for the vae_cond experiment. Relative paths are relative to this folder.

selection.rule: one row per distinct PhysicTran38K category; random.Random(f'{seed}:phystran_g1').sample(sorted(categories), n); first row (by id) of each picked category

conditions.none: no VAE condition; all 3 frames go to the ViT only
conditions.first: VAE-condition on F0 only; all 3 frames go to the ViT
conditions.all: VAE-condition on F0, F1, F2; all 3 frames go to the ViT
